QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Phantasmal Legacy
QuestInfo.0: Aoe is devastated after learning about the pestilence. Talk to him again.
QuestInfo.1: Aoe reflects on the teachings of his predecessors. But you should check on Sieg and see how he's doing.
QuestInfo.2: After reflecting on the past, Aoe and Sieg came out of the experience stronger. Thanks to their efforts, the city will remain for some time now.
